name: Silvery Dragon Group Co., Ltd. Tianjin
summary: Silvery Dragon Group Co., Ltd. Tianjin, together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures and sells prestressed steel products in China and internationally. It offers prestressed materials comprising galvanized (aluminum) wires for bridge cables, PC strands for wind power concrete towers, prestressed galvanized (aluminum) strands for photovoltaic, unbonded galvanized strands for hydropower, strands for nuclear power plant safety shells and low temperature LNG/LPG, prestressing systems of high-speed railway track slabs, PC wires for railway sleepers and PCCP pipelines, and PC bars for t-shaped continuous beams.
